title: Corrective actions
description: Nonconformities and observations from audits and from what Steward notices, with actions, owners and a check by a second person that the fix worked (ISO/IEC 27001 clause 10.2).

filters.oneControl: Only the findings of one control.
filters.oneSupplier: Only the findings about one supplier.

empty.title: No findings yet
empty.text: Record a finding of an audit, or confirm a suggestion Steward made from a missed duty, an incident review or an access review.

whoCanAct: Designers, administrators and the editors of a service record findings.

hints.sourceLabel: For example: External ISMS audit 2026, finding 4
hints.controls: The controls the finding is about: the finding shows on their panel on Controls and goes into their evidence packs.
hints.cause: Why it happened (root cause), as far as known
hints.grcRef: Where the risk lives in your GRC tool, e.g. a risk id – Steward keeps no risk register
hints.service: Editors of the service may change the finding
hints.supplier: The supplier the finding is about, for example from a supplier review
hints.owner: Who sees the finding through and is reminded

form.confirmIntro: The finding is filled in from the suggestion. Change what you need; it links to what it came from.

detail.notChecked: Not checked yet. Once every action is done and the finding is implemented, a second person checks that the fix worked.
detail.ownPart: You took part in the fix (as an owner of the finding or of an action – also as a member of an owning team –, by marking an action done or by changing one after the finding was implemented): a second person checks it.
detail.fourEyesOff: The assurance policy lets anyone who checks confirm their own fix.
detail.recordHidden: The actions are measures of an incident review you may not read.
detail.measuresNote: This finding's actions are the measures of its incident review {{record}}: they stay in the review, with its reminders.

actions.title: Actions
actions.ownersHint: They are reminded before the due date, on it and weekly while it is overdue.

effectiveness.title: Check effectiveness of {{number}}
effectiveness.intro: Confirm whether the fix worked. Effective closes the finding; not effective sends it back to in progress for a new action.
effectiveness.methodHint: For example: sampled five leavers of the last month; restored last week's backup

cancel.title: Cancel finding {{number}}
cancel.reasonHint: For example: recorded twice, or not a nonconformity after all

suggestions.intro: Steward suggests findings from its own events; a person confirms each one or dismisses it with a reason. The same event is never suggested twice.
suggestions.atLimit: {{limit}} suggestions are waiting: further ones wait until some are decided.
suggestions.empty: No suggestions wait for a decision.
suggestions.dismissReason: Why it is not a finding

titles.personReview: Person review “{{review}}”: {{count}} removal(s) not confirmed gone after {{days}} days
titles.reconciliation: Access check “{{check}}”: {{count}} finding(s) open for more than {{days}} days ({{week}})
titles.supplierCertificate: Certificate {{certificate}} of supplier “{{supplier}}” ran out on {{date}}
titles.supplierReviewMissed: Supplier review “{{duty}}” of “{{supplier}}” missed in period {{period}}
titles.supplierReviewFailed: Supplier review “{{duty}}” of “{{supplier}}” failed in period {{period}}

settings.intro: Which of Steward's events become suggestions. Nothing becomes a finding without a person; switched on, a source suggests the events of the last 90 days.

dutyMandatory.label: Missed or failed periods of mandatory duties
dutyMandatory.description: A period of a mandatory service duty that ended missed or failed.

dutyRecommended.label: Missed or failed periods of recommended duties
dutyRecommended.description: The same for recommended duties – off by default.

incidentMajor.label: Accepted incident reviews of severity major or critical
incidentMajor.description: Its measures become the actions of the finding.

incidentMinor.label: Accepted incident reviews of severity minor
incidentMinor.description: Off by default: not every incident is a nonconformity.

personReview.label: Person review removals still there after 30 days
personReview.description: An approved person access review whose removals are not confirmed gone 30 days after its approval.

reconciliation.label: Reconciliation findings open for more than seven days
reconciliation.description: Off by default. One suggestion per access check and week, however many findings are open.

supplierReview.label: Supplier reviews
supplierReview.description: A certificate of a confirmed supplier in use that ran out, and a missed or failed period of a duty that reviews a supplier (instead of the duty sources above).

controlPanel.title: Open findings
controlPanel.none: No open corrective action findings name this control.

supplierPanel.title: Corrective actions
supplierPanel.none: No open finding is about this supplier.
